findings.summary: Host preflight was optional at task initialization and evidence-writer boundaries.
findings.action: Plan now requires live host corroboration on task init and both new recorder modes, plus a direct-persistence inverse.

findings.summary: Agent-return identity could be restamped without validating stale or unavailable Git identity.
findings.action: Plan now rejects supplied identity mismatch and unavailable Git identity before stamping.

findings.summary: Review admission did not require recorder provenance and citations.
findings.action: Plan now enforces both at current sidecar admission.

findings.summary: AC-fit admission lacked exact source-envelope, plan, branch, and SHA binding.
findings.action: Plan now derives fit from one nested verifier payload and revalidates its recorded envelope digest.

findings.summary: New evidence modes could have accepted a non-canonical output root.
findings.action: Plan now fixes new modes to canonical task-keyed evidence paths.

findings.summary: A caller-supplied reviewer roster could shrink the required panel.
findings.action: Plan now derives required count and auditors from persisted tier and canonical routing.

findings.summary: Planned AC-fit output did not match the existing task-keyed consumer path.

limits: Plan admission only; implementation and real Claude auto-mode qualification remain unproven.
